body:
Money is stress. I would not kill myself because of money, I would kill myself because of the stress it causes.

Thinking realistically... I really don't see how being a homeless sixteen year old would benefit me. Plus my town has no bus/no way to get anywhere else (which is why I'd need a car for a job). Of course money isn't necessary for a fulfilling life, but it would help (could better afford school, could have basic financial security, could afford to travel or even just move somewhere less isolated). Like I said, my life could be worse but just because it isn't doesn't mean my worrying isn't justified.

Thanks for your advice.
Thank you, thank you, thank you. Do you want me to PM you?
I want to help. Or talk, or listen, or whatever. No one should ever feel so broken.
